about: Ground plan for 'Johnny Tremain' (Jack's comedy in two acts) on Theatre 2 of midtown.html. Read docs/johnny-tremain/set-format.md for the schema and docs/johnny-tremain/BREAKDOWN.md for the scenes. Positions in the STAGE frame; stage.frame.toWorld converts. Re-laid round the lifts 2026-10-16 (RULING GI): tools/jt-set-check.py checks it.

frame.axes: x + = STAGE RIGHT (the audience's left = house left = world +x); x - = STAGE LEFT (house right, world -x). z + = upstage of the proscenium plane (world +z: UPSTAGE IS +Z in this GLB); z - = the apron. y + = up from the deck.
frame.origin: the centre of the proscenium opening, on the deck, on the proscenium plane
frame.toWorld: world = (20.00 + x, 0.80 + y, 2.30 + z) — a pure translation (HOUSE2.dx 20.0; the arch is centred on GLB x 0.00; deck y 0.80; proscenium plane z 2.30)
frame.rotY: degrees about +y (three.js's sense). 0 = the piece's FRONT faces the house (-z); +90 = faces stage LEFT (-x); -90 = faces stage RIGHT (+x); 180 = faces upstage. A glTF model whose front is +z in its own file needs 180 added.
frame.placement: x, z = the centre of the piece's footprint; y = its BASE over the deck. size = [w along x, h, d along z] at rotY 0. Optional scale (uniform) and tipped (bool).

measuredWorld.source: assets/midtown-auditorium.glb read directly (fills by name, scan triangles Object_4...15), + HOUSE2.dx 20.0; checked against midtown.html (HOUSE, WALL_SET notes, BACKSTAGE, cutBeams' BEAM_BOX, RIG_TRIM, BOOTH_CUTS, WORKLIGHT). Theatre 2 is the uncut scan.

wings.SR: x 24.30...29.60 (5.30 m) upstage of z 3.90; downstage of it only x 24.30...26.00 (1.70 m): the SR side room (x 25.95...29.56, z 0.85...3.90, ceiling y 4.46) with its cross wall at z 3.81...3.90

hangingIron.note: the venue's own iron, uncut in Theatre 2 (house 1's was cut by BEAM_BOX). Pipes run UP/DOWNSTAGE, not across.

worklight.switchBox: stage-left wall (x ~10.5), z 3.30, 1.3 m over the deck
worklight.lamp: stage-left fly wall, y 11.40, z 4.60, aimed at (20.0, 0.80, 5.50)

measuredWorld.scanStrays: two loose flat scan triangles 0.8 m over the deck: x 15.18...15.66, z 7.67...7.96 and x 23.81...24.74, z 7.63...7.94 (y 1.61...1.64) — the second pokes 0.35 m out of the wharf deck; cut them (an HOUSE2_CUTS box) when the set goes in.
measuredWorld.seating: Object_13: first row at world z ~-2.0 (x 14.8...24.6), seated eye ~y 1.12 = only 0.32 m over the deck; widest rows z -4.5...-5.5 (x 11.4...28.5); back row z ~-14.0 (eye ~y 3.9)

flyLanes.note: flown pieces must fit a lane between the iron's pipes, or the iron is cut (Jack's call)

sightlines.frontRowSeesUpTo: y = 0.32 + 0.949 (z + 4.30) through the arch alone (10.5 at the back wall); with the masking border at z 3.0: y = 0.32 + 0.559 (z + 4.30) upstage of it (6.3 at the back wall)

vsWorklist.his: 6.6 m deep behind the arch + 2.65 m apron
vsWorklist.measured: 6.60 to the back brick (deck runs on to 6.70) + 2.65 apron
11.55 m is the APRON's width (the house's walls either side of the apron). The STAGE HOUSE's side walls are ~19.0 m apart (x 10.5...29.6)

vsWorklist.his: About 1.5 m of wing each side; the 1.3 m rule
vsWorklist.measured: SL 5.15 m the full depth; SR 5.30 m upstage of z 1.6 and 1.70 m only downstage of it (the SR side room). The 1.3 m rule is not needed: every travelling piece here parks in a wing or goes through the centre doors

fly roof at world y 16.0 = 15.2 m over the deck (16.0 over the house floor). Empty above the iron (5.1-5.4 over the deck) to the roof. But the front row sees 10.5 m up the back wall through the arch, so only a piece <= 4.7 m tall hides when flown out, unless a border is hung (with the border at z 3.0: <= ~8.9 m)

parks.SL wing: x -9.30...-6.30, z 0.2...6.4 (behind the legs; keep the switch box at x -9.45, z 1.0 clear)
parks.backstage: through the centre stage doors (x -1.0...+1.0, 3.40 high) into the crossover, stage z 7.0...11.1, x -9.6...+10.0
parks.flown: out-trim y given in trim.out; lanes between the iron's pipes
parks.lift: the basement (RULING GJ): a big set goes DOWN the back lift (stage x -2.5...+2.5, z 3.6...6.0) to a bay in MIDTOWN.under.bays and comes back UP the front lift (x -3...+3, z 0.3...2.7) (RULING GI); storage.wagon names the pieces that travel together, storage.bay the bay

pieces.name: The loft (deck, four posts, rail)
pieces.credit: "Free Wooden Scaffolding Set" by Just8 (sketchfab.com), CC BY 4.0

pieces.notes: Deck 3.6 x 1.8, top at y 2.40 (x -4.20...-0.60, z 4.40...6.20), 0.2 thick, on four 0.18 posts at its corners; clear under it 2.20. Rail 1.10 high (top 3.50) on the front, both ends and the back, with a 0.60 gap in the front rail at x -1.30...-0.70 where the ladder arrives. The chimney passes through the deck at its SL end (x -4.20...-3.80, z 4.80...5.20). The rail is the 'window' and the 'windowsill' of several scenes (15, 18, 21). The Lapham apprentices' loft (1-8), then the loft over the Observer (9 on). Re-laid 2026-10-16 around the lifts (RULING GI): turned to run up and down stage along stage left (x -4.55...-2.55, z 2.85...6.45), clear of the back lift (x >= -2.50) and the front lift (z <= 2.70); 2.0 wide x 3.6 deep; the ladder arrives at its downstage end.

pieces.name: Lapham furnace (hearth, hood, chimney)
pieces.credit: "Forge And Bellow" by RBG_illustrations (sketchfab.com), CC BY 4.0
pieces.licenceNote: CC BY: print the credit line
pieces.notes: Brick hearth 1.0 w x 0.8 d x 0.9 h, its mouth facing STAGE RIGHT (rotY -90) so Johnny works it in profile from x -3.0 without turning his back on the house; footprint x -4.20...-3.40, z 4.50...5.50, under the loft's SL end. Hood over the hearth, chimney up its SL side through the loft deck, top at y 4.40. Coals emissive with two states, lit/dark (an orange LED in the hearth on its own channel). Also plays every other hearth: the Lapham kitchen fire (1, 2, 7), Milton's kitchen where the Bible pages burn (17), Silsbee's Cove (26). Re-laid 2026-10-16 around the lifts (RULING GI): under the loft's upstage end, on its stage-right side (x -3.35...-2.55, z 5.30...6.30) so the front row's house-right seats see its mouth; mouth to stage right, the chimney up through the loft.

scenes.title: Up and About
scenes.location: The Lapham loft and kitchen, Hancock's Wharf; the street on the apron

segments.location: The Lapham loft and kitchen (morning, July 1773)
The street on the apron, the kitchen lit behind

scenes.notes: Pre-show dark, a gull, a bell; Johnny enters down a house aisle (followspot). Loft lit first (three boys), then the kitchen; the town pours across the apron as the street while the kitchen stays lit behind. Mrs. Lapham 'at the fire' is the hearth: an ember glow is optional.

scenes.title: Pride Goeth
scenes.location: The Lapham kitchen (no change)
scenes.notes: Breakfast round the table, the great Bible on it. No set change from 1. The three-boy bed stays on the dark loft and is struck in the 2-to-3 change.

scenes.title: The Sugar Basin
scenes.location: The Lapham shop
scenes.notes: Change: table off; workbench and polishing wheel on, the furnace cold; the armchair into the shop's corner; the door frame is the shop's way out to the street. The SCRIPT says the furnace is DARK here (the worklist says it glows in 3 and 6).

scenes.title: The End of the Wharf
scenes.location: The end of Hancock's Wharf at midnight, to dawn

segments.location: The end of Hancock's Wharf, midnight to dawn

scenes.notes: Change: the shop goes; planks run out to the edge of the stage, the floor round them lit as dark water, a single lantern. Dawn light finds the cup at the end.

scenes.title: Handles
scenes.location: Paul Revere's shop, North Square; the bare apron

segments.location: The walk home across the apron

scenes.notes: Revere's bench, stage right: tidier and brighter than Lapham's, tools laid out in order, a teapot. At the end Johnny crosses the empty apron on his way home.

scenes.title: The Crucible
scenes.location: The Lapham shop, Saturday afternoon then Sunday dawn

segments.location: The shop, Sunday dawn (half light, the furnace roaring)

scenes.notes: Back to the shop as in 3, the furnace lit and glowing. Blackout, rooster, Sunday dawn half-lit with the furnace roaring. The pour, the burn; the light closes to the bucket, the boy and the furnace.

scenes.title: What Was Left
scenes.location: The Lapham kitchen, weeks later
scenes.notes: The kitchen again, the furnace dark behind. Johnny in the big armchair (moved centre); a small chair in Mr. Lapham's corner.

scenes.title: Another Boy
scenes.location: The street

segments.location: Boston, a street of shop doors

scenes.notes: The kitchen goes; actors bring on door flats in a line across the apron (or become the doors themselves). Bare stage behind. Faster and funnier until it is not; Johnny alone; Cilla and the lime.

scenes.title: Salt Lane
scenes.location: Salt Lane and the Boston Observer's print shop
scenes.notes: The swing sign flies in; press, type case and counter come on. This set recurs: under ten seconds to assemble. Johnny shows his hand for the first time.

scenes.title: Let There Be Lyte
scenes.location: Copp's Hill at dawn; Lyte's counting house; the Lyte dining room

segments.location: Lyte's counting house on Long Wharf
The Lyte dining room, eight o'clock

scenes.notes: Three places in sequence. The four cups gleaming in a row on the sideboard; the light warms when Lavinia is seen; the arrest.

scenes.title: Lyte v. Tremain
scenes.location: The jail; the courtroom; the street outside
scenes.notes: Jail: cot and stool, the window only a pattern of bars in light. Courtroom: the Justice raised on the platform (the wharf deck), the dark bar rail, benches for the crowd, the cups on a table; eleven strikes. Outside: an empty sunlit apron and a step standing in for Lavinia's gig.

scenes.title: Goblin
scenes.location: The yard behind the Observer
scenes.notes: The print shop (sign and press) glimpsed through its door; a hitching rail and straw. The horse is the company in a line; it does a lap of the yard.

scenes.title: Salt-Water Tea
scenes.location: The loft over the Observer; Old South Meeting House; the deck of the Dartmouth

segments.location: The loft over the Observer, late November
Old South Meeting House, in darkness

scenes.notes: Loft: long table, punch bowl, bench, rafters; the Observers climb the ladder one at a time until the loft is full (it holds a line of six; the rest crowd the ladder and its foot). Old South: the loft is cleared and goes dark; the whole company crammed onto the floor round a single lantern. The Dartmouth: the wharf's timber becomes the ship's rail, tea chests, the auditorium is the harbour; Montague looks on from the apron. Fife. Blackout. END OF ACT ONE.

scenes.title: The Fiddler's Bill
scenes.location: The wharf by day; the camp on the Common; North Square
scenes.notes: June 1774. Wharf with ships' masts behind; the camp (tents, stacked muskets, rope line; Rab struck down); North Square at one o'clock (bare, a mounting block).

scenes.title: Commandeer
scenes.location: The stable yard of the Afric Queen
scenes.notes: Stays the whole scene: the stable door, the clothesline, Colonel Smith's window up on the loft, Lydia's basket. The sheet fills with wind like a sail.

scenes.title: Queen of Spades
scenes.location: The Lyte kitchen on Beacon Hill; the dove-grey drawing room; the kitchen
scenes.notes: Played as a split stage so nothing moves: the kitchen stage right (table, kettle, Mrs. Bessie's chair), the drawing room stage left (sofa, mirror, costume pieces, the tailor on the floor).

scenes.title: The Haunted House
scenes.location: The town gate on the Neck; the road; the Lyte house at Milton; the Milton road at dawn

segments.location: The town gate on the Neck, night
The Lyte house at Milton: the dining room

scenes.notes: The gate by torchlight: a step for the guardhouse, the ruby coach no more than two lamps and a wheel. The road (two chairs for the chaise, a lantern). Milton: the abandoned dinner, twenty candles lit one by one, four cups; the lantern through the dark house picking out, one by one, Lavinia's dressing table, the wig on its stand and an overturned chair; the kitchen hearth where the pages burn; every shutter closing is a bang from offstage. Dawn on the road, the Minute Men crossing. Johnny's question to the house, and the wait for an answer.

scenes.title: Green Apples
scenes.location: The orchard behind the Lyte house; the loft windowsill
scenes.notes: The orchard bench under hanging branches, the apron lit as the sea below the hill; a short cut to the loft rail, where the apple is left and Rab eats it.

scenes.title: A Man Can Stand Up
scenes.location: The loft over the Observer (the last meeting); the truckle beds

segments.location: The loft, the last meeting of the Observers

scenes.notes: As in 13 (trestle, punch bowl), plus the armchair given to Otis; the rafters he shoves upward. Then the table goes and two truckle beds are laid on the same loft; Johnny alone to the house (a hinge: do not rush).

scenes.title: Eyes and Ears
scenes.location: Green Dragon; the Afric Queen yard; the Observer; the Common; the camp and the runaway; the loft; the salt marsh

segments.location: The Observer (the torn letter; Dove drunk)
The encampment; the runaway; the Lytes' back gate

scenes.notes: Seven places, winter to April. The hurdles; the runaway (the company builds and strikes each obstacle; ends dead still at the Lytes' back gate); the smock; the pewter going into the crucible; the execution on the marsh (drums, the volley, eight round eyes).

scenes.title: New Evolutions
scenes.location: The Afric Queen; the loft; Warren's surgery; the Dawes kitchen; North Square and Copp's Hill; the surgery

segments.location: The Afric Queen: the posted order; the stable
North Square; Copp's Hill; Salem Street; the alley
The surgery again; midnight; dawn at Lexington (sound)

scenes.notes: April 15-18, the company announcing each date like a clock striking, every section quicker. Rab leaves Boston (up the ladder's foot, out through the centre doors as Salt Lane). The campaign saddle. Copp's Hill by moonlight; the two lanterns come on high in the spire. Almost midnight; Johnny sleeps. Dawn: one shot, a volley.

scenes.title: Yankee Doodle
scenes.location: Warren's surgery at dawn; the street and the Common; Salt Lane; the pasture behind Beacon Hill

segments.location: The street and the Common: Percy's brigade
Salt Lane wrecked; Aunt Jenifer's kitchen
The pasture behind Beacon Hill, sunset

scenes.notes: April 19. The surgery; children chanting; Percy's brigade on the Common, the flag, the drums, Yankee Doodle; Salt Lane wrecked (sign, press, the boys' bed) and Aunt Jenifer's kitchen across the way with the feather bed; the pasture at sunset, distant lights, musket flashes like fireflies.

scenes.title: Aunt Lavinia
scenes.location: The Lyte kitchen; the front of the house beyond as light and noise

segments.location: The Lyte kitchen, the house emptying

scenes.notes: Stays in the kitchen: table, two chairs. The front of the house (carts, trunks, portraits going out) is light and noise beyond: the centre stage doors open behind the door frame Lavinia stands in. The uniform goes on; Johnny exits down the hill.

scenes.title: Across the Water
scenes.location: The ferry slip at night; Charlestown; the Cambridge road and Menotomy; a well at the Lexington line

segments.location: The ferry slip, North Boston, night
A well at the Lexington line

scenes.notes: The slip, a warehouse corner and a tanning shed either side and two torches; the boats exist only as light and sound coming from the auditorium; Colonel Smith and Stranger lifted from a dory. Charlestown: clothesline, pump, tavern corner, flour barrel. The road at morning (burials). The well; eight names.

scenes.title: Better So
scenes.location: Lexington Green; the back chamber upstairs at Buckman's

segments.location: The back chamber upstairs at Buckman's

scenes.notes: The Green in late-afternoon leaf shadow, the tiny belfry, Buckman's as a doorway, the Harrington steps. The chamber: Rab propped in the armchair on pillows, a window, his musket leaning in a corner, the pewter candlestick. Johnny tells the house he will stop for a bit (a hinge).

scenes.title: Stand Up
scenes.location: Silsbee's Cove; the lower parlour at Buckman's; Lexington Green at sunset (finale)

segments.location: Lexington Green at sunset: the finale

scenes.notes: Silsbee's Cove: the empty red armchair by the hearth, hens as sound, Grandsire's gun gone. The parlour: table, window, the musket; Warren frees the hand. The Green at sunset: everything struck back to the unit set, every member of the company in low sunset light, the dead among them and Rab at the back; Grandsire's chaise passes; Johnny's hand open at his side; fife; blackout.
